system.description:
You convert chakra into earth and spit it from your mouth, or use earth that’s already present to quickly generate a large wall. The wall is 5 Feet Thick, 30 Feet Long and 25 Feet High and if the wall is generated within a creature's space, the creature is pushed to either side of the wall (Your choice).

The wall can have any designs or shape you decide. The Wall has an AC of 20, 5d6+25 Hit Points, and 6 DR vs all damage excluding Lightning damage. This wall is also resistant to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage that are not a result of a jutsu.

This wall counts as an Earthen Artifact.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the walls hit points by 1d6+5.

trigger.text: 1 Action or 1 Reaction, which you take when you or another creature you can see in range would take damage.
